d51f289c57c046d39426ae90a9ace6e8.name: Petroglyph H20, Khatm Al Melaha, Kalba, Sharjah
d51f289c57c046d39426ae90a9ace6e8.description:
Natural Version with Paint, Petroglyph H20, Khatm Al Melaha, Kalba, Sharjah. One poorly defined animal. Likely Neolithic or earlier. [Fossati 2019 Messages from the Past: Rock Art of the Al-Hajar Mountains (Oman)].

Khatm Al Melaha is an archaeological site on the coast of the Oman Sea near Kalba in Sharjah, UAE. It is one of the largest rock art sites in the UAE.

Over 175 stones with petroglyphs were documented and close to 400 motifs were identified. Every rock with a glyph was given an ID number and a GPS coordinate. In total 25455 terrestrial photographs, 5244 drone photographs, 44 drone videos, and 182 GPS points (+/- 1cm) were done in a single day.

Petroglyphs were identified using Radiance Scaling in Meshlab, materials lighting in Substance Painter, and by changing conditions in Sketchfab. Some carvings were completely invisible when viewing. Drawings were done only when a line could be identified using one of these techniques.

Reality Capture and Substance Painter

837c9fa18e024e8a82293e2145e91fd8.name: Scifi revolver 2.0
837c9fa18e024e8a82293e2145e91fd8.description: A revolver (also called a six shooter or a wheel gun[1][2]) is a repeating handgun that has at least one barrel and uses a revolving cylinder containing multiple chambers (each holding a single cartridge) for firing. Before firing a round, cocking the hammer partially rotates the cylinder, indexing one of the cylinder chambers into alignment with the barrel, allowing the bullet to be fired through the bore. The hammer cocking can be achieved by either the user manually pulling the hammer back (as in single-action), via internal linkage relaying a rearward movement of the trigger (as in double-action), or both (as in double/single-action). By sequentially rotating through each chamber, the revolver allows the user to fire multiple times until having to reload the gun, unlike older single-shot firearms that had to be reloaded after each shot.

ac4cf4a0ee1740a08478bc9be83454e9.name: Adze Holder with Haft Notch, XCB-105-3699
ac4cf4a0ee1740a08478bc9be83454e9.description:
Adze Holder with Haft Notch, Sea Mammal Bone, XCB-105-3699. 400 BCE-100 CE. This is one half of holder for the adze bit. Notch for wood handle.

XCB-105 Adamagan (Aleut for place of walrus hunters) is at the head of Morzhovoi Bay, western Alaska Peninsula. It is a massive village with multiple occupations. When it was occupied 400 BCE-100 CE, it was the largest village in the Arctic with an estimated 1000 people. It also has limited occupations dated 2200-1700 BCE, 1000-600 BCE, and 900-1100 CE. 

The Western Alaska Peninsula artifacts are presented as a result of the research conducted under grants NSF 9630072, NSF 9814086, NSF 9996372, NSF 9996415, NSF 1139266, NSF 1321411. H. Maschner, Principal Investigator. These artifacts were scanned with either a Faro Edge Arm or a Minolta Vivid 9i. Processed in Geomagic or Polyworks. 2-8 photos were used for texture in Geomagic Wrap. Original digitizing work done at the IVL at Id. St. Univ. Subsequent processing and publication completed at Global Digital Heritage.

Support the Free 3D Model Library for only $1 per month: https://www.patreon.com/meerdigital

Enhance your projects with this premium model of a purple scallop. This model has a very lean polygon count at 252, making it perfect for real-time applications or quick render times in ray tracing engines. The geometry comprising this model has been whittled down from a photoscanned model to the minimum possible while still retaining most of its visual quality.

Features:

* 252 polygons quads / 504 when triangulated
* All quad geometry, no tris or n-gons
* 2048px by 2048px textures for PBR workflows (Albedo/Color, Normal & Ambient Occlusion)
* Non-overlapping UV Map
* Real world scale set in centimeters

559b7a2ae50f426a8993b609d22931ff.description: Fossil fruit of the flowering plant *Koelreuteria allenii* from the late Eocene Florissant Flora of Florissant, Colorado. The fruits of *Koelreuteria* are inflated and somewhat leaflike in appearance. This specimen shows one segment of an inflated fruit. *Koelreuteria* (Sapindaceae, soapberry family), or golden raintree, is today native to Asia, although it may be seen in cultivation elsewhere. Specimen is from the Cornell University Paleobotanical Collection (CUPC), Ithaca, New York (#1584-5). Length of leaf is approximately 4 cm. Model by Emily Hauf.

0f0b5de866ad4fc9a3ded786c7396b1d.description:
A chert Guilford projectile point curated at the Natural History Society of Maryland. The Guilford point is characterized by a long, narrow, thick blade with a straight, rounded, or concave base. This point type dates to the latter part of the Middle Archaic period ranging from 6200 to 5500 BP (approximately 5250-4350 BC).

Courtesy of the Natural History Society of Maryland which has given permission for the model to be downloadable for non-commercial educational purposes.

607dc7e18cb04f3fbeb169078e3ea87a.name: HL-103 Bone Labret, Hot Springs Village, Alaska
607dc7e18cb04f3fbeb169078e3ea87a.description:
Decorated Bone Labret, Hot Springs Village, Port Moller, Alaska CAT# HL-103
Okada excavations HL02. Hot Springs 2B 500-850 CE

The Hot Springs site is a massive village on the shore of Port Moller, on the Alaska Peninsula side of the southern Bering Sea. It was excavated by several different teams over the last 100 years. The main occupations are from 2000 BCE-1000 BCE, and from 100 CE to 800 CE.

The Hot Springs artifacts are presented as a result of the research conducted under grants NSF 0137756, NSF 1204020, NSF 1139266, and NSF 1321411. H. Maschner, Principal Investigator. Original digitizing work done at the IVL at Id. St. Univ. Subsequent processing completed at Global Digital Heritage.

9ed2b9c9f146440b935a9934f967b517.name: WW2 - City Scene
9ed2b9c9f146440b935a9934f967b517.description:
*~ Spring, 1940 ~*

*This had to be it, one battle, all or nothing. 
A swift landbattle with heavy support of the Luftwaffe was needed to take control over the vital bridges. If the Nazi's crossed the Meuse, there was nothing left to stop them from reaching Paris and Calais...*

*~ Autumn, 1943 ~*

*The German conquest of Sedan has left the city broken. These new rulers never bothered to repair their inflicted damage. But something has changed, rumours of a possible Allied landing in France were starting to spread amongst the people. Definitely after the Italian armistice with the Allies.*
 
*The French resistance acted out of despair, but now hope has returned within their small ranks...*


This is my first end assignment for 3D low poly. 
We had to choose one of the various themes. I love history so I did't have to think long. 
The assignment made me a proud Sketchfab Plus member, due to the file being to big :)
But nonetheless I enjoyed making it and hope to please you with the result.

This is another photogrammetry test. Testing a reproducable setup and procedure. And well, unfortunatelly it wasn't very reproducable. Nevertheless, I got a quite okay-ish model.

Setup: OpenScanner (www.openscan.eu) in a light tent with 3 soft boxes, Sony Alpha 77 II, SAL100M28 (100mm / f2.8 Macro), 4 chunks with 668 RAW images total, processed in lightroom, Agisoft Metashape, minor texture editing in Photoshop.

d3eaa3c222364b418e08a3e3d72d0485.name: Black Painters Tape
d3eaa3c222364b418e08a3e3d72d0485.description:
** Black Painters Tape Roll **

*2" inch x 60yd STIKK Black Painters Tape Roll.*

*11.8 x 11.7 x 5.1 cm (60 micrometers per texel @ 4k)*

Scanned using advanced technology developed by inciprocal Inc. that enables highly photo-realistic reproduction of real-world products in virtual environments. Our hardware and software technology combines advanced photometry, structured light, photogrammtery and light fields to capture and generate accurate material representations from tens of thousands of images targeting real-time and offline path-traced PBR compatible renderers.

Zip file includes low-poly OBJ mesh (in meters) with a set of 4k PBR textures compressed with *lossless* JPEG (no chroma sub-sampling).

ce53df6c36024a8ea12ccbf79a0a34a0.name: Fortress Bastion Training Room
ce53df6c36024a8ea12ccbf79a0a34a0.description:
A room in one of the 19th century bastions of Fortress Monostor (located in Komárom, Hungary, at the south side of the river Danube) repurposed between the interwar period for an infantry training room with training information, silhouettes and sectional drawings painted on it's brickwalls. The north facing windows got overgrown with ivy creating an old castle like atmosphere in person. Some orange led lights were built inside the ledge of the walls. Too my surprise the room wasn't simmetrical there were slight differences between the two halfs.

The scan was mostly done with a Sony A6000 and partially with a Samsung S10+, ~400 images.

My workflow (probably not the most optimal):
Agisoft Metashape -> Meshlab decimation -> InstantMeshes remeshing -> Blender touch up -> Agisoft retexturing.

1abf6124c37a4cf3a5bd6edd5012725f.name: COVID-19 Infection, Stay Home!
1abf6124c37a4cf3a5bd6edd5012725f.description:
A useful model to explain the importance of staying at home, breaking the link between thousands and saving lives.

**Watch the video here: **

* **[English](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nemSzeqs1lo&t=)** 
* **[Spanish](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yHg2nBNmerA)** 

**Theory & Concept**

* PhD Maia Majumder says this chain of corona virus has a R0 of 3, meaning one person can infect up to 3
* While, the ordinary Flu has a R0* of 1.3, for example
* So one person can have contact and infect up to 3 more
* However, these people will spread it over 3 more each
* Through a chain of 10, the flu would reach 14 people only
* With COVID-19, through the same 10 levels it could easily reach 59,049

**More Info:**

* Maia Majumder, PhD [Twitter](https://twitter.com/maiamajumder) 
* [Thread](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3524675) for COVID-19 R0's

**Stay Informed: **

* https://www.who.int/emergencies/diseases/novel-coronavirus-2019

30256f207c5e4500befb371273ab6878.description:
3D model of an iron candle holder with hardwood at the end. The object itself is 68.6 mm long and the cylinder, where the candle could be inserted, is 31.6mm long. The physical object can be found at the National Museum of Iceland nr:2003-36-511. Found 7/ 8/ 2003 by RG https://sarpur.is/Adfang.aspx?AdfangID=1884043

Part of the Skriðuklaustur Monastery 1550 reconstruction.

Digitisation by Open Virtual Worlds, a research team within the School of Computer Science, University of St Andrews, in cooperation with the Gunnar Gunnarsson Institute at Skriðuklaustur and the National Museum of Iceland. 3D digitisation was done by Catherine Cassidy and Iain Oliver with archaeological assistance provided by Skúli Gunnarsson.

Funded by the EU Northern Periphery and Arctic Programme 2014-2020 through the “Connected Culture and Natural Heritage in a Northern Environment” (CINE) project.

8e9386da0d5440c5b8af50b7d0660372.name: Instructional Chess - Knight
8e9386da0d5440c5b8af50b7d0660372.description:
Instructional Chess demonstrates – on the body of each piece – how pieces are allowed to move on the board. Seen from above, squares represent potential "landing" places for each piece, beyond which they may not move, while arrows represent the possibility of continuous movement across the board. 

Each piece was custom designed in virtual reality (Oculus Medium) and 3D printed for proof-of-concept testing. I hope to get this instructional chess set into the hands of local educators, chess clubs, etc., so younger users can engage with a game shown to improve cognitive processes (particularly those associated with mathematics and spatial understanding).

*The pieces have been designed to be printed without support material.*

http://www.mncook.net/professional/ for more info.

aa26039fca994ad89137a789e9ea0dd5.name: UNSC Savannah. Halo Frigate Free High Poly Model
aa26039fca994ad89137a789e9ea0dd5.description:
a high poly, high detail, clean and accurate model of the UNSC Savanna Frigate from Halo: reach. 
 this model was my final project for my 3D modeling class. 5 months ago i had never touched a cad software. but the moment i did, 3d modeling was immediatly my new favorite hobby. every detail and aspect of this model was done entirely by me, and reflects all that i have learned in the past five months. 
 this model was achieved entirely through fusion 360, it took me about 12-18 hours of work time and trouble shooting. despite this being my biggest project to date, it went cleanly and smoothly almost entirely throughout. 
 i write this on my last day of school and plan to make more models over the summer with a focus on 3d printing. by the end of summer i plan to release a version of this model that is easily printable. (you can still probably print this one but i dont recommend it)
 as i am still a novice student, i not only appreciate but need constructive critasism, please tell me how i can improve. thanks.

3e9f9c7502664d868cebedd9b105be55.name: Life Under Quarantine
3e9f9c7502664d868cebedd9b105be55.description:
Created for the [Newgrounds "Shelter In Place" art jam](https://www.newgrounds.com/bbs/topic/1450105).

I had trouble exporting the transparent material on the record player. You can see [what it's intended to look like on Newgrounds](https://www.newgrounds.com/art/view/omarshehata/my-world-under-quarantine).

I've never really considered myself an artist, but I was just so inspired by this shelter in place jam I felt like I had to try. I absolutely love this idea of everyone sharing how their entire worlds have been collapsed into these little cubes and what they have in there that's been keeping them going.

That's my world right now under COVID-19. It's kind of fun to compare this with a [real-life photo of the scene](https://www.newgrounds.com/dump/item/d8dc412b380bca56290e36c164e6cf1e).

Made with Goxel.

2c4b5869390c4982b4594b046a6f868e.description:
**Clean photogrammetry assets from bimage **

*Model optimization Process* 

- - photoscanning from 20 to 200 pictures depending on object complexity 
- - 3d meshing and texturing with meshroom or reality capture 
- - model cleaning with blender 
- - quad remeshing with instant mesh 
- - texture baking with blender (4K diffuse + normal + roughness + AO + displacement) 
- - exporting FBX, OBJ, DAE. 

**This are optimized assets**; each 3d blender file is from 5 to 20 Mo including the 4K jpg textures. 

www.bimage.co

7a254d4350ea4df389d940ef5abffdef.name: Petroglifo Taboexa - 2 Panel  2
7a254d4350ea4df389d940ef5abffdef.description:
Los petroglifos de A Coutada fueron descubiertos tras los incendios de 2017.

Tras el hallazgo del petroglifo, los arqueólogos fueron a visitarlo. Los expertos quedaron maravillados al ver que no se trataba de dibujos de ciervos, como suele ser habitual, sino de figuras de équidos. De este modo pudieron confirmar “un nuevo paradigma en el arte rupestre gallego y portugués” sobre el que llevaban dos años trabajando: la gran roca inclinada existente en Taboexa muestra pequeñas cavidades repartidas por su superficie, algunas figuras abstractas, antropomorfos sexuados y, lo más importante, más de 20 zoomorfos en distintas direcciones, prácticamente todos ellos équidos y en distintas actitudes: con jinete, sin él, con jinete portando un arma, con cánidos para ser capturados, entre otros. Y es que en el arte rupestre gallego se imponía hasta ahora la figura de los ciervos y los caballos aparecían en escasas ocasiones y con un papel secundario.

Fuente: Faro de Vigo (https://n9.cl/oy0mi)

738d21a84f43412d8ebb4da2c055340f.name: The Rock at MSU
738d21a84f43412d8ebb4da2c055340f.description:
"The Rock" at MSU (located off Farm Lane near the north bank of the Red Cedar River) is an important part of the cultural landscape for the university. Acting as a billboard, the Rock is painted by students to advertise events, bring awareness to causes, participate in political discourse, and much more. 

Originally unearthed at the intersection of Grand River Ave. and Michigan Ave. in East Lansing in 1873, the Rock was the first official class gift to the college from the class of 1873. It was placed in the Sacred Space near Beaumont Tower and bore "Class '73" carved into it, now unseen due to numerous paint layers.  Rather than standing upright, it laid flat on the ground and became a popular spot for couples to get engaged, which gave it the nickname "Engagement Rock".

The Rock was moved to its current location in 1985 and has since become a university-wide medium for free speech.

CAP fellows painted the Rock in May 14th, 2019 so that this model could be made.

Photogrammetry model made by Jack A. Biggs

5b9887bd24814d7a909d576abb0662b6.name: Mégacéros

Photogrammétrie d'une reproduction à l'échelle 1:1 (hauteur totale : environ 3 m) d'un mégacéros réalisée en résine polymère par la société Ophys basée à Prayssas (47) pour l'ArchéoParc de la Dame à Brassempouy (40) en 2014. 
Le mégacéros est un cerf géant (taille au garrot pour les mâles : 2 m / envergure des bois : jusqu'à 3,50 m) ayant vécu en Europe et Asie centrale durant la dernière glaciation. 
Un fragment de bois de mégacéros découvert sur le site archéologique des Grottes du Pape à Brassempouy a donné son nom à une partie du site : la Galerie du mégacéros.
***Photogrammétrie CESAR Guy - MARTINS Frederico***

15bbda759c394c22a37c0319b5619c4d.name: Ameer - Model
15bbda759c394c22a37c0319b5619c4d.description:
Unfortunately, I was unable to use a 3D scanner to capture a model of my body, so I instead used a tripod to take 4 photos of myself:

1. In front view (me head on looking into the camera)
2. Back view (behind me)
3. Side/Profile (my right and left side)
4. Back Side/Profile

After that, I made some adjustments to the photos using photoshop to white balance them, allowing me to grab all the necessary details I needed to depict the shape of my body.

### Modeling Myself
After the prep work was done, I opened up Make Human, to grab a generic 3D model of a male figure, and began customizing the following parameters to get it as close to my body type as possible. Once that was completed, I reopened photoshop to compare them and see if I had captured the essence of my body. I did spend a few hours tinkering with rigging the 3D form of myself and made a few posters for fun.  of Myself through MakeHuman.

This is an improved version of my last model. 

1) I've added 6 holes to bottom for inserting M8 bolts for added weight. The magnet that attaches the Watch to the charging disk is so strong that the whole thing might come along when removing the watch. Extra weight helps with this.

868ad08b11e245078410ae8aa70a7068.name: Zelda Ocarina of time Fan Art: Ganon
868ad08b11e245078410ae8aa70a7068.description:
Yet another zelda fanart! I guess ocarina of time is such an Iconic game I couldn't resist doing ganon! It was first sculted on Zbrush and then shoved into blender for retopo, the textures were made on substance painter, I guess this is the reason why my room was so hot this summer haha! 

I didn't really like ganon's design in smash bros ultimate and i always wonder how this fearfull creature would look like in hd, that's why i tried to recreate the dark lighting of the orignal OOT, i think it makes him look so much more terrifying! They did such a wonderfull job with the lighing, composition and silhouette that I can only try to imitate such great scene! 

It was also mainly modeled with the original ganon artwork for ocarina of time, as there was no other artwork in this style, it made the whole thing much harder but it was a fun creative exercice, having reference is good and using them is appreciated but i just love wondering how something would look like in 3d, and is to me a usefull skill.

386629230df9465888976d4cd96e54e3.name: Mountrivers ogham stone
386629230df9465888976d4cd96e54e3.description: One of 2 ogham stones discovered c. 1840 when a flour mill (Mullenroe) was demolished on the site of a possible ringfort in tld of Mountrivers, Co. Cork. The 2nd ogham stone is in the British Museum. This stone was used for a time as a foot bridge over the Delehinagh river. In 1851 it was erected beside nearby St Olan's holy well. It is heavily covered with lichen and moss and the ogham inscription reading [MADOR]A MAQI DEGO is worn at the lower end. A cross has been rubbed onto the face by visitors to this pilgrimage site. 3d model created using photogrammetry (40 images) and processed with Agisoft PhotoScan

e80cda84613a4ab888f40609a59139b9.name: LLGRID6 (2014) low-res
e80cda84613a4ab888f40609a59139b9.description:
**Aeolian soil erosion, Kangerlussuaq, West Greenland**  
*June/July 2014*  

We are researching erosional and ecological processes in these *deflation patches*, which cover 22% of the local landscape. Katabatic winds off the Greenland Ice Sheet remove fine-grained loess soil, exposing glacial till. The patch edge advances as soil and vegetation are undercut. Within patches, a biological soil crust forms, hindering future erosion and aiding soil recovery.   
  
**People**  
Ruth Heindel, Earth Sciences, Dartmouth  
Ross Virginia, Arctic Studies and Environmental Studies, Dartmouth  
Jonathan Chipman, Geography and Earth Sciences, Dartmouth  
Becca Novello  
Phoebe Racine  
  
**Sources**  
http://sites.dartmouth.edu/rheindel  
  
Heindel, R, Chipman, J, Virginia, R, 2015. [The Spatial Distribution and Ecological Impacts of Aeolian Soil Erosion in Kangerlussuaq, West Greenland][id]. Ann. Assoc. Am. Geogr. 105:875-890.
[id]: http://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/00045608.2015.1059176

**Ejemplar**: *Pomacea insularum* **Nombre común**: Caracol manzana **Descripción**: Gasterópodo de gran tamaño (hasta 7cm), color pardo-amarillento, concha globosa y dextrógira. Acuático, pero adaptado a períodos de falta de agua y fuertes precipitaciones, gracias al opérculo que le permite cerrar su concha. Invasora en río Ebro y Gran Canaria. Originaria de zonas tropicales y subtropicales húmedas de África, Centroamérica, Sudamérica y sureste de Asia. Vector de introducción: escapes desde criaderos o sueltas ilegales de ejemplares mantenidos en cautividad.**Sigla museo, colección y entidad**:  MUVHNZM0001. Colección del Dpto. de Zoología (Fac. 5367189e88e14cdb9cb136a81e77753f.name: Textiles: Zhadov, "A Profitable Position"

user.displayName: Department of clothes pattern design IVSPU

5367189e88e14cdb9cb136a81e77753f.description:
The 3D model presents a digital reconstruction of historical textile materials for a theatrical costume for Vasily Zhadov in the play "A Profitable Position" (1856) by A.N. Ostrovsky. The authors used 2D scanning to capture the look of the surfaces, post processed the images in PixPlant, generated texture maps in Photoshop and put those on the 3D models in SubstancePainter.

The authors of the 3D model are Aleksei Moskvin and Mariia Moskvina (Saint Petersburg State University of Industrial Technologies and Design).

The authors thank prof. Victor Kuzmichev (Ivanovo State Polytechnic University) for providing data required for digitization of textiles. The actual costume that can be seen in the photo was made by faculty members and students of Ivanovo State Polytechnic University.

35924f07444349b9a1fc2cfd63d1249a.description:
Section of a pot showing traces of a fissure (of an incompletely joined coil). The original pot was produced by experimental archaeologist Caroline Jeffra with the wheel-coiling method as defined by Roux-Courty (1998), shown below. 
![](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Caroline_Jeffra/publication/317545934/figure/fig30/AS:504406546317317@1497271300319/FOUR-METHODS-OF-RKE-AND-COIL-COMBINATION-ROUX-AND-COURTY-1998-749-FIGURE-1.png)
View our blog post about wheel coiling [here](https://tracingthewheel.eu/article/what-is-wheel-coiling) 

Forming video available via [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eFa7Qp_TWb0&list=PLyt_a_oW7xtJVBfWakoEXQBj4XjDGWpUi&index=11&t=0s)

**Technical specs**
The original vessel was scanned with the David SLS-3 scanner and processed with HP 3D Scan Pro 5 by archaeologist Loes Opgenhaffen. The part with the relevant trace(s) was then extracted with 3D modelling software Maxon Cinema4D, upscaled 3 times, and exported to .STL.

8b3d9008b5924caf920a73cf926a32d1.name: Verteris Roman Fort / Brough Castle
8b3d9008b5924caf920a73cf926a32d1.description: The Roman fort of Verteris was constructed on the highest part of a ridge on the south bank of Swindale Beck, a tributary of the River Eden, slightly downstream of its confluence with Augill Beck. It lies at the western end of the Stainmore Pass, a route followed by the main Roman road through the Pennines that connects the Roman legionary fortress at York (Eboracum) with the fort at Carlisle (Luguvalium). The occupation of the fort possibly dates from the governorship of Agricola (AD 78-84) to the end of the C4. The fort’s enclosure measured about 3 acres (1.2ha) while an extra-mural settlement or vicus lay on the fort’s east side and a Roman cemetery lay to the east of the vicus. The only evidence for the Roman garrison station at Brough comes from later copies of the Notitia Dignitatum, an official late-C4/early C5 listing of Roman civil and military posts throughout the empire, which names the garrison at about this time as the Numerus Directorum.

627490798bcd40bf8cbf6c847236f1ec.description:
Roman sarcophagus with the representation of the god Apollo accompanied by the nine Muses. 200-210 aD. Carrara marble. Piece found in the Corpus Christi chapel of the Cathedral of Tarragona.
Old refectory room of the Diocesan Museum of Tarragona. Cathedral of Tarragona.
208 x 65 x 12 cm

The nine muses:
1. Clio: Discovered history and guitar.
2. Euterpe: Discovered several musical instruments, courses and dialectic.
3. Thalia: She was the protector of comedy.
4. Melpomene: Opposite from Thalia, Muse Melpomene was the protector of Tragedy.
5. Terpsichore: She was the protector of dance; she invented dances, the harp and education.
6. Erato: She was the protector of Love and Love Poetry.
7. Polymnia: She was the protector of the divine hymns and mimic art.
8. Ourania: She was the protector of the celestial objects and stars.
9. Calliope: She was the superior Muse. She was accompanying kings and princes in order to impose justice and serenity.

10bd72adfbfd4993b6ff672a31b337cc.name: Head of a Votary from the Temple of Golgoi
10bd72adfbfd4993b6ff672a31b337cc.description:
Helmeted and bearded head of a votary of carved limestone; in the archaic Cypriote style; the beard radiating with intersections; the helmet is quilted and framed and allows one row of curls to show above forehead. Ears are showing; a vigorous representation in nearly perfect state of preservation. From the temple of Golgoi. ;votary in the temple of Golgai; head only; archaic, cypriote style; radiating beard, quilted helmet; archaic smile; strong frontality.

https://collections.artsmia.org/art/350/head-of-a-votary-from-the-temple-of-golgoi-ancient-greek

I shot 23 photos in DNG. The head is mounted on a tall pedestal against a wall so photographing it is tricky. As you can see from my model, I couldn't get the top and rear of the head.

I took the DNGs and processed them in Adobe Lightroom for detail, clarity, and evened out the exposure to make them consistent. I also tried to correct for color cast (but I did't quite succeed as the limestone is more white than my model shows).

1a279038d8064c60a6040b5d9a716299.name: Artefato 3 com Reconstrução do Acabamento
1a279038d8064c60a6040b5d9a716299.description:
Essa simulação 3D foi baseada em uma ponta de flecha do acervo do Museu Universitário de Arqueologia e Etnologia (MUAE) da Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS). Modelo feito por João Vinícius Chiesa Back, estudante de História da UFRGS e participante do Centro de Tecnologia Acadêmica (CTA). A partir do artefato arqueológio, foi elaborada a reconstrução do seu acabamento.

Dados do Objeto Datação: 7 - 6 mil anos atrás. Local de Achado: Rio Grande do Sul, região da Campanha, atual Alegrete. Material: Lítico, pedra. Função: Caça e/ou combate. Cultura: Caçadores e coletores do RS. Dimenções: Cerca de 3,5 cm de comprimento e 2.5 de altura.

Modelo 3D feito para usos didáticos em projeto pedagógico desenvolvido no MUAE durante o período de estágio obrigatório do curso de História.

Link para acesso do objeto no instagram do museu: https://www.instagram.com/p/CICF4xbrLeB/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link.

Obs.: As penas na parte posterior do objeto são de quero-quero, ave habitante do Rio Grande do Sul.

10a45eacb263426a8b14eae9524a1e1b.name: Stittenham Pictish Wolf Stone
10a45eacb263426a8b14eae9524a1e1b.description:
This fragment of a fine 7th century AD Pictish symbol stone was found built into an old wall at Stittenham, Ardross, Ross and Cromarty, Scotland at some point prior to 1863.  It was found with a second fragment of decorated stone that depicts a beast (https://skfb.ly/6nxLB).  This stone is 0.31m high by 0.49m wide and 0.13m thick.

For more information on this stone see [CANMORE](http://canmore.org.uk/site/13738) and the [Catalogue of Pictish Art in Inverness Museum](http://her.highland.gov.uk/hbsmrgatewayhighland/DataFiles/LibraryLinkFiles/192822.pdf)

This stone is one display in the superb galleries of [Inverness Museum and Art Gallery](https://www.highlifehighland.com/inverness-museum-and-art-gallery/).

c448e9f39c404290a200b585418c6146.name: Four

Four and their co-host X first appeared in the 2008 video "X Finds Out His Value". They appear to be abstract beings representing real-life numbers, letters, or algebraic variables.Four exhibits very surreal mannerisms, including being able to deform or mutilate characters, revive them, screech to stun them (killing them on some occasions), eliminate them by sucking them into their body (sending them to the EXIT), and shoot energy beams from their hands.Four's first appearance in BFB was "Getting Teardrop to Talk", where they lead a game to win a BFDI.In "B.F.B. = Back From Beginning", Four merged into the Desert. They reformed to their original state in "Chapter Complete."Four also makes a brief cameo in "You Know Those Buttons Don't Do Anything, Right?".

c9320ac244e5479789bfd1abab3d3b4a.description:
#Du befinner dig här:
![trappa2](https://pub.raa.se/nedladdning/sketchfab/bilder/lokaliseringssymboler/trappa2.jpg?dl=0&raw=1)

Detta rum, kallat övre förstugan, var nog tillsammans med de intilliggande trapporna lite utav byggnadens nav. Här var det fullt av liv och rörelse med både springande tjänstefolk, familj och gäster på väg mot borgstugan eller andra rum i huset. Idag finns Vildmannen, eller Jätten som han också kallas, placerad här och det hör till husets seder att hälsa på honom när man passerar. Det sägs att den som missar det kan drabbas av olycka...

För [bildrättigheter](https://www.raa.se/g3dmr).

** Salomon Men's X RAISE Hiking **

*The Salomon X RAISE hiking shoe features a modern, athletic look & is designed with features to support stability, comfort, & performance so no matter the trail, you can go the distance.*

*32.0 x 11.4 x 12.2 cm (116 micrometers per texel @ 4k)*

Scanned using advanced technology developed by inciprocal Inc. that enables highly photo-realistic reproduction of real-world products in virtual environments. Our hardware and software technology combines advanced photometry, structured light, photogrammtery and light fields to capture and generate accurate material representations from tens of thousands of images targeting real-time and offline path-traced PBR compatible renderers.

Zip file includes low-poly OBJ mesh (in meters) with a set of 4k PBR textures compressed with *lossless* JPEG (no chroma sub-sampling).

7faaae6fa13d41c3a69953e3d36fa4fb.description:
Charmeleon is a bipedal, reptilian creature. It has bright-red scales and a cream underside. There is a horn-like protrusion on the back of its head, and it has narrow blue eyes and a long snout. It has relatively long arms with three sharp claws. Its short legs have feet with three claws and cream-colored soles. The tip of its long, powerful tail has a flame burning on it. The temperature rises to unbearable levels if Charmeleon swings its tail.

Charmeleon has a vicious nature and will constantly seek out opponents. Strong opponents excite this Pokémon, causing it to spout bluish-white flames that torch its surroundings. However, it will relax once it has won. It is rare in the wild, but it can be found in mountainous areas.

0fdd57c3879a4083a3ff3fda27c6918b.name: Temple of Eshmun
0fdd57c3879a4083a3ff3fda27c6918b.description:
Photogrammetry reconstruction using de aerial dataset from Cyark Open Heritage Project: https://artsandculture.google.com/project/cyark

The Temple of Eshmun (Arabic: معبد أشمون‎) is an ancient place of worship dedicated to Eshmun, the Phoenician god of healing. It is located near the Awali river, 2 kilometres (1.2 mi) northeast of Sidon in southwestern Lebanon. The site was occupied from the 7th century BC to the 8th century AD, suggesting an integrated relationship with the nearby city of Sidon. Although originally constructed by Sidonian king Eshmunazar II in the Achaemenid era (c. 529–333 BC) to celebrate the city's recovered wealth and stature, the temple complex was greatly expanded by Bodashtart, Yatan-milk and later monarchs. 
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Temple_of_Eshmun

79082e37e9b3441f8f45fb61f08feef0.description:
This 3D model is of the ruins of the Early Christian Basilica of Sofiana located near Piazza Armerina, Sicily. The ruins date to as early as the 4th Century AD. Multiple tombs are present around the structure, particularly adjacent to the apse. The model was made in Reality Capture using 250 drone images.

The data for this project were originally collected as a joint effort between the University of Catania and CVAST at the University of South Florida (USF), with the collaboration of the Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK). Dr. Mariarita Sgarlata and Dr. Herbert Maschner, Principal Investigators. We gratefully acknowledge the participation of the administrators of the Villa Romana del Casale and the Museo Archeologico di Aidone. The data have been transferred to Global Digital Heritage (GDH) for processing and analysis. Funding for this project, both at USF and at GDH, has been provided by the Hitz Foundation, Herbert Maschner, Principal Investigator.

8661f164eac94897b2be7a1251545ddb.description:
Capiteles de la portada principal de la iglesia protogótica (s. XIII) de Santa María de la Peña de Brihuega (Guadalajara, España). Se encuentran sobre las arquivoltas de la izquierda de la portada y son los únicos capiteles originales que (aún en mal estado) se conservan en la portada.

Representan el momento de la Adoración de los Magos: la Virgen María con el niño reposando sentado en su regazo (a la izquierda) recibe a los tres Magos (en el centro) seguidos por un paje que lleva dos caballos tirando de un carro con más presentes.

9d7456f25298471aa7b736f2e1c3ffd9.name: Ju88
9d7456f25298471aa7b736f2e1c3ffd9.description:
The Junkers Ju 88 was a German World War II Luftwaffe twin-engined multirole combat aircraft. Junkers Flugzeug- und Motorenwerke (JFM) designed the plane in the mid-1930s as a so-called Schnellbomber ("fast bomber") that would be too fast for fighters of its era to intercept. It suffered from a number of technical problems during later stages of its development and early operational roles, but became one of the most versatile combat aircraft of the war. Like a number of other Luftwaffe bombers, it served successfully as a bomber, dive bomber, night fighter, torpedo bomber, reconnaissance aircraft, heavy fighter and even, during the closing stages of the conflict in Europe, as a flying bomb.
The assembly line ran constantly from 1936 to 1945, and more than 16,000 Ju 88s were built in dozens of variants, more than any other twin-engine German aircraft of the period. Throughout the production, the basic structure of the aircraft remained unchanged.
Wikipedia

e3ce5ff8d950442992c6f728c7807cd6.name: Czar radio receiver

user.displayName: Museum of Engineering and Technology, Krakow

e3ce5ff8d950442992c6f728c7807cd6.description:
The Czar (Polish for “Charm”) mono radio receiver was launched in 1960. In terms of the electrical system, it is a battery powered superheterodyne, comprising seven transistors and two germanium diodes. The maximum running time of the radio is between 60 and 120 hours. The radio operates in the medium and long wave bands, with amplitude modulation (AM). The receiver has a built-in ferrite antenna and a magnetoelectric speaker. The cuboid, relatively flat housing of the receiver is made of plastic that is bonded to a broad strip of perforated sheet metal running across the front side. The Czar was one of the first radios in Poland produced using printed circuit boards.

Manufacturer: Zakłady Radiowe im. Marcina Kasprzaka, 1960s

Inv. No.: MIM751/V-182

Model prepared on the basis of photogrammetric measurements

Licence: CC BY-NC-SA

87afa3c2f651473cbb74c41ca8cfba65.name: Equus neogeus – tooth
87afa3c2f651473cbb74c41ca8cfba65.description:
This is a 3D laser scan of part of a molar tooth of *Equus neogeus*. It is in two parts (the other part is specimen number NHMUK PV M 16558 b). The tooth was collected in 1832-1833 at Punta Alta in Argentina by Charles Darwin and is between 129,000 and 11,700 years old. It is part of the Earth Sciences collection at the Natural History Museum, London. This has been scanned as part of the Museum’s Darwin Fossil Mammals digitisation project. Find out more at www.nhm.ac.uk/darwinsfossils.

64mm x 31mm x 20mm.

[What is *Equus*? ](https://www.nhm.ac.uk/our-science/our-work/digital-collections/digital-collections-programme/darwins-south-american-horse-puzzle.html)

Specimen number NHMUK PV M 16558 a
Visit the dataset (https://doi.org/10.5519/0086786) and specimen record (https://data.nhm.ac.uk/object/d509c00f-4404-4202-98d3-99d52cdbafc8) on the Museum’s Data Portal for images and to request high resolution scan data.

72f7c58bc377486aa7401b86efd4c8fd.name: Azara's Domed Armadillo (NHMW-Zoo1-MAMM)
72f7c58bc377486aa7401b86efd4c8fd.description:
3D model based on a microCT scan of a frozen Southern three-banded armadillo, also known as Azara’s domed armadillo (*Tolypeutes matacus*). These animals live in South America and can be found in Bolivia, Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay. They can be as long as 25 centimeters and weigh up to 2 kilograms. It is the only armadillo species that can roll up into a complete ball.

This particular armadillo will be mounted by our taxidermists to be part of an upcoming exhibition at the NHMW in 2022.

**Specimen**: *Tolypeutes matacus* (Desmarest, 1804)

**Inventory number**: NHMW-Zoo1-MAMM

**Collection**: NHMW, 1st Zoological Department, Mammal Collection (curator: Frank E. Zachos)

Find out more about the NHM Vienna [here](http://www.nhm-wien.ac.at/en).

Download info: "Additional file" contains the meshes for this model as STL files.

MicroCT scan (YXLON FF35 CT), segmentation and 3D model by Viola Winkler (NHMW).

Processing of the microCT data: Dragonfly 2021.1 & Blender 2.93 

Infrastructure funded by the FFG.

65d8ac931dd74573b15d9f9a8c10dcd6.name: Berolina (Berlin-Alexanderplatz)
65d8ac931dd74573b15d9f9a8c10dcd6.description:
In December 1895, Hundrieser's naturalistically formulated monumental sculpture "Berolina", the female personification of the city of Berlin dressed in a baroque-antique style, was placed on Alexanderplatz near the Tietz department stores'. In 1896 he showed a galvanoplastic model of Berolina at the Berlin International Art Exhibition. In 1927 it was removed because of the building of the underground railway, but the figure with its massive granite base, which had become very popular in the meantime, was put up again in 1933 due to numerous protests from the population. In October 1944, the plastic, which was made of copper sheet metal, was dismantled and melted down for the extraction of raw metal; the base was removed in 1958.

**See the object in our database: https://sammlung-online.stadtmuseum.de/Details/Index/348418**

**CC-BY-Attribution: Stadtmuseum Berlin | Oliver Ziebe**

5efbf320e4184119b9d4ead911f31120.name: Monumentul Armatei Franceze a Dunării
5efbf320e4184119b9d4ead911f31120.description:
Primul Război Mondial transformă orașul Giurgiu (reședință a județului Vlașca și port al Capitalei la Dunăre) în teatru de război. În 1916, Giurgiu a fost ocupat de către armatele Puterilor Centrale (contingente germane, austro-ungare, bulgare și turce), jefuit și incendiat, suferind pierderi foarte de mari (cca. 50% dintre locuințe au fost distruse).
După doi ani de la invazie, la 10 noiembrie 1918, orașul a fost eliberat de Armata Franceză a Dunării, condusă de generalul M.M. Berthelot.

Monumentul comemorează contribuția Armatei Franceze în lupta de eliberare a Giurgiului.

fa0e41e9aaec494181fcb5b1b9ec6a58.name: Jarro - Fajalauza-HD (36)
fa0e41e9aaec494181fcb5b1b9ec6a58.description:
Jarro (CE08525-53-1200) producido en los talleres de Fajalauza (Granada, España). Ha sido modelado a torno y cocido en una atmósfera oxidante. Tiene una forma cerrada, parte de un labio redondeado y borde con orientación semi vertical que continúa en un cuello estrecho y un hombro curvilíneo cóncavo. El cuerpo es recto y la base plana. Del cuello arranca un asa de puente con sección semiplana. Presenta un pico vertedor de forma semiesférica. Está decorado con un motivo de flor de centro reticulada con carocas verticales.

* Cronología: 1600-1699.
* Depósito: Museo Arqueológico y Etnológico de Granada. 

[FAJALAUZA-Hd](https://acortar.link/bNsUsm)

Colaboran: [PRINMA](http://blogs.ugr.es/prinma/), [UGR](http://www.ugr.es), [Fundación Fajalauza](https://acortar.link/shJ8ps) , [Museo Arqueológico y Etnológico de Granada](https://acortar.link/DF0cOC), [Patronato de la Alhambra y Generalife](https://acortar.link/FcstHW)

7ac89a7a7aca4d2aa763510ee310cdf9.name: Bristow Fire Engine
7ac89a7a7aca4d2aa763510ee310cdf9.description:
An old wooden fire engine now located in the vestibule of St Magnus the Martyr Church, Lower Thames Street, London.

From the nearby sign:
"FIRE ENGINE, late 17th/early 18th century. The only fire engines available during the Great Fire were manually operated hydraulic pumps, which were difficult to manoevre round the narrow streets. The real development in fire engine design came during the 1670s when Dutchman Jan van Heiden devised a special hose and suction pipe, and his fellow countryman John Lofting, a resident of London, started manufacturing them."

237 photos taken in October 2021 with a Sony a7R III and processed in Reality Capture.
Back is poorly captured because fire engine is against a wall.

a0f6c4da88e644ac90c6f6a973ce11cc.name: Model 51 - Kemps Ridley Sea Turtle (with ID)
a0f6c4da88e644ac90c6f6a973ce11cc.description:
This is a 3D model (“Tumbleweed”) of a juvenile Kemps Ridley Sea Turtle (ID 132) (*Lepidochelys kempii*) that was initially rescued by the New England Aquarium in Massachusetts, and then photographed with the Beastcam technology with 30 Canon G16 cameras. The sea turtle was released soon after in the Southern United States in good condition. The 3D model was initially created through a photogrammetry scan using Capturing Reality.

Animator Robert Gutierrez used Blender to reconstruct the full sea turtle from these scans, as well as animate the movements. Jeanette Wyneken from Florida Atlantic University, and Connie Merigo from the New England Aquarium each provided feedback on the movements.

Downloads are freely available for creative and non-profit use. To inquire about licensing, please visit www.digitallife3d.org

72acf11625134ae8b1bd38ce65282b9f.name: Maqueta en la Roca, Cupo.
72acf11625134ae8b1bd38ce65282b9f.description:
Esta maqueta, tallada en la roca, corresponde a otra versión algo diferente a la que encontrarás en esta página (maqueta en la roca, altiplano chileno). 
Se encuentra ubicada en el poblado de Cupo, en la región de Antofagasta. 
El rol que este tipo de expresión jugo en las sociedades prehispánicas aun no es del todo claro, sin embargo, es posible correspondan a la representación de hitos del paisaje en relación a sus actividades o practicas (campos de cultivo, manejo del agua, reproducción).

Los invito a leer este articulo, el que aborda este tema.

79d794ecc37c4c0b8e30aefececa08b7.name: Palacio de Justicia de la Nación (Argentina)
79d794ecc37c4c0b8e30aefececa08b7.description:
Proyectado por el arquitecto francés Norbert Maillart en 1889  y comenzanda la construcción en 1905. Una parte del Palacio fue inaugurada en 1910 en el marco del Centenario de la Revolución de Mayo. Sin embargo, faltaba aún mucho por construir, y la Corte Suprema se instaló en el nuevo edificio recién en 1912. En 1914, en el marco del estallido de la Primera Guerra Mundial y por problemas administrativos y presupuestarios, la obra queda suspendida, para retomarse recién en la década de 1920.
Se dice que el Palacio de Justicia fue completamente terminado recién en 1942.

f004d317462646448b64810a1561902b.name: UTS 3D Modelling - Castle in the Jungle
f004d317462646448b64810a1561902b.description:
A hidden and private castle for recreation, 

Description:
The Castle Empire is the most suitable game for the terrain, 
the game genre is Action and Strategy where the players have the rights to edit and structure the whole world with freedom, the same as my own game which is created to satisfy user's needs.
There are two scenarios for the game:
1. As the User
2. As the Avatar
As the User we will have the authority to edit the world, while as the avatar we will enjoy and utilize the terrain and structures given
There could be a fight in the terrain, depending on enemy's attack, it could be preemptive

Role of the props:
1. Castle: as the main building that signals the game's health, when the castle is demolished, the game ends
2. Platform: as a decorative place where the fight shouldn't end up at
3. Tent: as the protection from aerial attacks and serves also as a shade for the sun
4. Bed and Lamp: is the place where the avatar will rest and recover its stamina
5. Tree: decor

Andy Julianto

After I had basic features of the model created I started to subdivide the model more and pulled around areas with soft selection. Finally, I used Maya's sclupting tools to create more fine tuned details. Although this is a pretty low detail model, it is able to get the point of what an organic model is. The difference between hard surface and organic modeling is that you must use a higher poly count to create more smooth and organic shapes for organic models.

56ee4be599ed44498e9f52bac949f963.description:
Studzienka (rząp, beczka) – publiczny zbiornik z wodą pitną zlokalizowany w sąsiedztwie obecnej ul. Grodzkiej 16, na dawnym placu przy farze lubelskiej pw Św. Michała.  Studzienka miała średnicę około 1,2 m i wysokość około 1 m. miała kształt beczki ściśniętej na dole obręczą metalową (4), a od góry obręczami drewnianymi (8). Woda do beczki prowadzana była drewniana rurą zasilającą (1). W jej górnej części były 2 otwory. W pierwszym znajdował się drewniany korek tzw. klapka (3) przez który woda napływała z rury do beczki. Drugi otwór wywiercony pod kątem 60 stopni i zwężający się ku dołowi (2) służył do zamknięcia napływu wody z rury do zbiornika. W trakcie napływu wody klapka się podnosiła a następnie opadała w dół kiedy ciśnienie w zbiorniku było wystarczająco duże. Do studzienki od strony fary prowadziło dojście wyłożone drewnianymi belkami.

61b91d720c3f448a86af07fb7eb8d1c6.name: Morro da Lagoa - Feição pós-movimento de massa
61b91d720c3f448a86af07fb7eb8d1c6.description:
Este modelo apresenta um corte no regolito para abertura de via de acesso. Data da coleta: 19/10/16.

Localização: “Morro da Lagoa”, na bacia hidrográfica do rio Itacorubi na região central da Ilha de Santa Catarina, Florianópolis, Santa Catarina.
Tamazzoli et. al (2014) caracteriza a rocha matriz da seguinte forma:
“Rocha granítica de cor cinza-claro ou rosada, geralmente com fenocristais de feldspato potássico sobre matriz granular fina ou média. Associa-se frequentemente às rochas vulcânicas da suíte Cambirela ou ao granito Ilha, sob a forma de enclaves nas primeiras ou de veios graníticos intrusivos na última. Podem também formar corpos intrusivos de maior porte.” Há também, na mesma região Dique Básico “Diabásios de cor escura, afíricos, afaníticos ou faneríticos finas, médias ou grossas. Termos de granulação mais grossa ocorrem no centro de diques mais espessos e podem ser classificados como gabros. Formam diques com espessuras variadas, podendo localmente atingir até cerca de 200 metros.”

***Aachhorn***

*Mansfeld, Luthers Elternhaus*

*um 1500*

*Irdenware*

*L 10,5 cm (Originalfragment); L ges. 35 cm*

>Landesamt für Denkmalpflege und Archäologie Sachsen-Anhalt

Dieses Signalhorn aus Pfeifenton war ein Andenken an eine Pilgerreise nach Aachen in Westdeutschland. Der Dom der Stadt beherbergt noch heute die Sammlung an textilen Reliquien, die zu Luthers Zeit für die wichtigste in Europa gehalten wurde.
_____________________
***Pilgrim’s Horn***

*Mansfeld, Luther’s parents’ home*

*Around 1500*

*Earthenware*

*10.5 cm (original fragment), W (max.) with reconstructions 35 cm*

>State Office for Heritage Management and Archaeology Saxony-Anhalt

This pipeclay signal horn was a memento of a pilgrimage to Aachen in West Germany. The town’s cathedral still holds what was then considered to be the most important collection of textile relics in Europe.

---
Literature: Nebelsick, L., 'Pilgrim’s Horn', in: Harald Meller et al. (eds.), Martin Luther. Treasures of the Reformation. Dresden 2016, No. 6

0bb2d26d4a9245ada9874aa2ff81dc11.name: The Strike By Greg James 1991
0bb2d26d4a9245ada9874aa2ff81dc11.description:
THE STRIKE BY GREG JAMES 1991.
This sculpture depicts the gold strike near Coolgardie by prospectors William Ford and Authur Bayley in 1892 which unleashed the gold rushes that secured the future of the struggling colony of Western Australia. Established one of the states most successful and enduring industries and led to the foundation of the Perth Mint in 1899.

This stone marks the location of a time capsule laid by the Premier of Western Australia. The honourable R.F Court MLA. On the occation of the Perth Mint's centenary 20 June 1999.

user.displayName: The Royal Museums of Art and History

4de5e01d5c46492bbc619a77e40409f6.description:
It concerns a type 2 vessel in the typology of the El Argar culture of the Siret brothers, excavated in the southeast of Spain. These hand shaped bowls with conical base come from funerary contexts, where they are often found together with type 8 vessels. This type of ceramic is characterized by a dark, polished, metallic surface. (Argaric culture, 2300 BC - 1600 BC). Inv n.: PG.2000.1449

Find this object in the museum’s online catalog [Carmentis](https://www.carmentis.be:443/eMP/eMuseumPlus?service=ExternalInterface&module=collection&objectId=197291&viewType=detailView)

6ac20380e87849f3bfbfc785fc56597b.description:
The avocado (Persea americana), a tree likely originating from south-central Mexico, is classified as a member of the flowering plant family Lauraceae. The fruit of the plant, also called an avocado (or avocado pear or alligator pear), is botanically a large berry containing a single large seed. Avocado trees are partially self-pollinating, and are often propagated through grafting to maintain predictable fruit quality and quantity

Avocados are cultivated in tropical and Mediterranean climates of many countries, with Mexico as the leading producer of avocados in 2019, supplying 32% of the world total.

71a6805f759b40a9aaddb1bccf8acf02.name: XFP-056 Burnishing tool, Sanak Island, Alaska
71a6805f759b40a9aaddb1bccf8acf02.description:
Bone burnishing tool, Sanak Island, Alaska. CAT# XFP-056-4-1

XFP-056 is a group of large house depressions on the south shore of Pauloff Harbor, Sanak Island, Alaska. Multiple radiocarbon dates place it from 300 CE to 800 CE, although the upper most levels may date to the 13th century.

These artifacts were scanned with either a Faro Edge Arm or a Minolta Vivid 9i. Processed in Geomagic or Polyworks. 4-8 photos were used for texture in ZBrush. The Sanak Island artifacts are presented as a result of the research conducted under grants NSF 0326584, NSF 0508101, NSF 1139266, NSF 1321411. H. Maschner, Principal Investigator. Original digitizing work done at the IVL at Id. St. Univ. Subsequent processing completed at Global Digital Heritage. Fieldwork and analysis done with the permission and collaboration of the Pauloff Harbor Tribe and the Sanak Corporation

3fdbfa9754024a9b9c5de33b6d15ae40.name: The Great Kiva at Casa Malpais
3fdbfa9754024a9b9c5de33b6d15ae40.description:
This structure is a large ceremonial room at the ancient village now called Casa Malpais, near the Town of Springerville Arizona. The structure was probably built in the late thirteeth century as part of the western Pueblo tradition. Great Kivas such as these were present at most villages in the Mogollon highlands during this period of time.

This village is open for guided tours, check in with the Casa Malpais Musuem at the Springerville Hertiage Center, 418 E Main St, Springervile, AZ.

The digital model was created with Photoscan Pro using 300 images, and was decimated down to 400,000 faces from a reference scan of 20,000,000 polygons.

96abab2a1bda4888af6f03ad3888aa66.name: Artificial reef REXCOR, Marseilles, 2017
96abab2a1bda4888af6f03ad3888aa66.description:
REXCOR is an ecological restoration project that consists of immersing 36 innovative artificial reefs in the degraded shallow seabed of the Cortiou Calanque. This area having suffered the effects of the outfall of the Marseille sewage treatment plant, it is a question of proposing a viable solution to favor the return of the marine life in this sector.The increase in biodiversity and biomass are evaluated by several methods (photographs, visual counts, samples ...) including photogrammetry. This tool has many interests, particularly in terms of time tracking.

Underwater photogrammetry carried out as part of a collaboration between Septentrion Environnement and LIS (Laboratory of Computer Science and Systems) Aix-Marseille University, UMR CNRS 7020. 

Contact : Olivier Bianchimani, Septentrion Environnement and Pierre Drap, LIS, CNRS.

810e9981450f418ba332bfdb56d78ff5.name: RK18 T00217 Timber
810e9981450f418ba332bfdb56d78ff5.description:
RK18 T00217 is a timber found during the archaeological excavation of the Rooswijk in 2017. The concretion was excavated by conservators and archaelogists in the conservation facility.

In 2017 and 2018, the shipwreck of the Rooswijk, a 300 year old Dutch East India Company (VOC) ship which sank on the treacherous Goodwin Sands in January 1740 off the coast of England, was excavated by an international team of maritime archaeologists. Post-excavation work began straight after each excavation campaign, focusing on ex-situ research, the conservation and analysis of the artefacts and will continue until the end of the project. The #Rooswijk1740 project is funded and led by the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands (Ministry of Education, Science and Culture), in collaboration with project partner Historic England and UK-contractor MSDS Marine.

Follow #Rooswijk1740 on social media and https://english.cultureelerfgoed.nl/topics/maritime-heritage/shipwrecks/rooswijk1740

be994934a8a049849f522b5f8df7689c.name: Ancient Theatre, Sagalassos, Turkey
be994934a8a049849f522b5f8df7689c.description: The theatre at Sagalassos, Turkey, was built between 120 and 190 CE, possibly preceded by an earlier construction in the Hellenistic tradition. Its construction was stopped by the end of the second century CE, with parts of the seating unfinished and a stage area of only one story. It could seat thousands of spectators. In this model one can also visualize the corridor behind the theatre seating. This model was constructed from 4520 photos (Phantom 4 Pro [20mpx], Sony A7iii [24mpx], A7riii [45mpx], and Leica Q2 [47mpx]) and 232 Faro S70 laser scans. The model was processed in Reality Capture. The data were collected by Global Digital Heritage in August 2019, as part of the University of Leuven Sagalassos Archaeological Research Project and supported by the Global Heritage Fund.

3ebf6f26353b4a9f843071f1bbb4b19b.name: Petroglyph N2 Khatm Al Melaha, Kalba, Sharjah
3ebf6f26353b4a9f843071f1bbb4b19b.description:
Natural Version, Petroglyph N2 Khatm Al Melaha, Kalba, Sharjah. Two Syrian Wild Ass. Likely Neolithic or earlier. [Fossati 2019 Messages from the Past: Rock Art of the Al-Hajar Mountains (Oman)].

Khatm Al Melaha is on the coast of the Oman Sea near Kalba in Sharjah, UAE. It is one of the largest rock art sites in the UAE.

Over 175 stones with petroglyphs were documented and close to 400 motifs were identified. Every rock with a glyph was given an ID number and a GPS coordinate. In total 25455 terrestrial photographs, 5244 drone photographs, 44 drone videos, and 182 GPS points (+/- 1cm) were done in a single day.

Petroglyphs were identified using Radiance Scaling in Meshlab, materials lighting in Substance Painter, and by changing conditions in Sketchfab. Some carvings were completely invisible when viewing. Drawings were done only when a line could be identified using one of these techniques.

Reality Capture

0e196e434b134051990f3ea4ae10ad71.name: Not a Black Hole - 1
0e196e434b134051990f3ea4ae10ad71.description:
Given the recent scientific news and the fact that I'm on the "experimenting with volumetrics" path, I figured out that trying to reproduce space objects with simple force-driven particle simulation could be a fun exercise. Here are some first tests !

This object was made by moving 1000 particles around (rigid body rotation initial speed, one central repulsive force and two attractive ones), and "registering" their paths in an alpha voxels grid (225x225x225), which I finally mapped to textured planes for the volumetric effect.

A final central sphere was used with refraction parameters to create the center "black hole".

Might be resource intensive, sorry for that !

0c16db638e0a45f2b4cbcb87fe455e6a.name: A twin capital with decoration of plant motifs
0c16db638e0a45f2b4cbcb87fe455e6a.description:
The presented twin capital is one of four such column capitals discovered over the years 1947–1953 during archaeological research carried out while reconstructing the eastern wing of the monastery.
The double capitals in the collections of the Museum of the Benedictine Abbey in Tyniec are among the best examples of Romanesque masonry in Poland. They come from the first monastic foundation in Tyniec. However, researchers do not agree whether the twin capitals were originally located in the church or in the cloisters.
The fully preserved twin capital has the shape of two truncated pyramids turned upside down and connected in the upper part by a high cuboidal abacus. At the base, both segments are surrounded by an echinus. The surface of the capitals is covered by clearly visible plant motif decoration consisting of large, deeply carved and sharply outlined leaves.

11th/12th century, Tyniec

Museum of the Benedictine Abbey in Tyniec

Inventory number: DA/153/2012

bf997fc79afd48be8a46fac876663ffd.name: Roper Token
bf997fc79afd48be8a46fac876663ffd.description:
The Beholder, lying broken on the ground, has yielded a key that will allow your party through the gate, into the unknown depths below.  After, what seems like hours, of walking down a slimy, musky, spiral causeway you find yourselves in a large cavern with a low hanging ceiling.  You can make out the shapes of countless stalactites slowing making their way to the cavern floor. The sound of dripping water echos and you decide to search for a fresh source.  Several feet into the cavern, you notice that your thief has disappeared.  Everyone stops as the mage cast another orb of light.  There is a shrill screech and a sudden thud as the thief crashes to the floor.  Several tentacles lash at the light from a nearby stalactite, and thats when you hear your thief yell "Watch out! The're Ropers on the ceiling!


Roll for initiative.

59d9cb4c2f70447994236e939dec5619.name: Biface Fragment XCB-003-116
59d9cb4c2f70447994236e939dec5619.description:
Biface Fragment XCB-003-116

XCB-003, or IZM-003, is a site tested by A.P. McCartney in 1971. It is the type-site for the Izembek Phase. A small village with a unique whalebone house and many artifacts similar to those in the Bristol Bay region. It dates approximately 1200-1350 CE.

The Western Alaska Peninsula artifacts are presented as a result of the research conducted under grants NSF 9630072, NSF 9814086, NSF 9996372, NSF 9996415, NSF 1139266, NSF 1321411. H. Maschner, Principal Investigator. These artifacts were scanned with either a Faro Edge Arm or a Minolta Vivid 9i. Processed in Geomagic or Polyworks. 2-8 photos were used for texture in Geomagic Wrap. Original digitizing work done at the IVL at Id. St. Univ. Subsequent processing and publication completed at Global Digital Heritage.

1. McCartney, A.P. 1974 Prehistoric Cultural Integration along the Alaska Peninsula. APUA 16(1):59-84. 2. Maschner: doi: 10.1353/arc.2011.0007 Arctic Anthro. January 1, 2004 vol. 41 no. 2 98-111.

Modified Sea Mammal Bone XCB-105-4124. 400 BCE-100 CE.

XCB-105 Adamagan (Aleut for place of walrus hunters) is at the head of Morzhovoi Bay, western Alaska Peninsula. It is a massive village with multiple occupations. When it was occupied 400 BCE-100 CE, it was the largest village in the Arctic with an estimated 1000 people. It also has limited occupations dated 2200-1700 BCE, 1000-600 BCE, and 900-1100 CE.

The Western Alaska Peninsula artifacts are presented as a result of the research conducted under grants NSF 9630072, NSF 9814086, NSF 9996372, NSF 9996415, NSF 1139266, NSF 1321411. H. Maschner, Principal Investigator. These artifacts were scanned with either a Faro Edge Arm or a Minolta Vivid 9i. Processed in Geomagic or Polyworks. 2-8 photos were used for texture in Geomagic Wrap. Original digitizing work done at the IVL at Id. St. Univ. Subsequent processing and publication completed at Global Digital Heritage.

e0ceee85e98d4be38446a0944910bc9e.name: Echinopora lamellosa (NHMW-Zoo3-EV15251)
e0ceee85e98d4be38446a0944910bc9e.description:
3D scan of the calcium carbonate skeleton of a stony coral (*Echinopora lamellosa*). *Echinopora lamellosa* can be found across the tropical Indo-Pacific ocean, down to depths of 35 meters. IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature) attributes this species a conservation status of Least Concern. 

This specimen, originated from Samoa, was scanned as part of a pilot study to identify new morphological traits for species delimitation, and it is not on display in the showrooms of the NHM Vienna.

**Specimen**: *Echinopora lamellosa* (Esper, 1791)

**Inventory number**: NHMW-Zoo3-EV15251

**Collection**: Natural History Museum Vienna, 3rd Zoological Dept., Evertebrata varia Coll. (curator: Pedro R. Frade)

Find out more about the NHMW [here](http://www.nhm-wien.ac.at/en).

Scanned and edited by Aliah-Noor Hashmi & Anna Haider (NHMW)

Scanner: Artec Space Spider. Infrastructure funded by the FFG.

6a605a3c4edd4fef843ef431def90ea6.description:
Natural Version, Petroglyph C25 Khatm Al Melaha, Kalba, Sharjah. Three human feet or foot prints. Likely Neolithic or earlier. [Fossati 2019 Messages from the Past: Rock Art of the Al-Hajar Mountains (Oman)].

Khatm Al Melaha is an archaeological site on the coast of the Oman Sea near Kalba in Sharjah, UAE. It is one of the largest rock art sites in the UAE.

Over 175 stones with petroglyphs were documented and close to 400 motifs were identified. Every rock with a glyph was given an ID number and a GPS coordinate. In total 25455 terrestrial photographs, 5244 drone photographs, 44 drone videos, and 182 GPS points (+/- 1cm) were done in a single day.

Petroglyphs were identified using Radiance Scaling in Meshlab, materials lighting in Substance Painter, and by changing conditions in Sketchfab. Some carvings were completely invisible when viewing. Drawings were done only when a line could be identified using one of these techniques.

4ba4996b018d44acb2d465614bdde473.name: The Great Shigir Idol_part 9
4ba4996b018d44acb2d465614bdde473.description: The Great Shigir Idol discovered in 1890 in the course of a gold mining operation at the Shigirpeat bog is the oldest known monumental wooden sculpture. In 2014 a team of archaeologists andscientists from Russia and Germany have undertaken a comprehensive study of idol. The originalsculpture was 5.3 m high, the height of the surviving part was 3.4 meters. All in all (together withthe images from the lost part) eight personages were represented on the Great Shigir Idol. It was established that the idol was made from a freshly cut treetrunk with the help of polished stone adzes and chisels. The sculpture was initially positioned vertically, probably on a stone foundation, and than it fell into the lake and sank in its shallow part at the time of peatformation, some of which was preserved in the ancient cracks. According to the AMS results together with the other available data the age of the idol was about 9,600–9,000 cal y. a., which corresponded to the beginning of the Mesolithic.

0222b2e45aa64d2198af548ea107a64a.description:
This model was made by close-range photogrammetry.

Reconstructed from high-quality photos and processed by Agisoft. ColorChecker was used to achieve the correct representation of colours from the real world to sRGB.

This model was optimised using retopology.

We also created a new effective unwrap UVs, that allowed creating 4k normal maps, achieved by the correct transfer of textures from high poly to low poly.

038d61501656417aa1b3979c26ac3243.name: Zebra Plant
038d61501656417aa1b3979c26ac3243.description:
Scanned with 3D Live Scanner and the Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra.

From https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aphelandra_squarrosa

"This plant flourishes in abundant, but not direct, light. It does not bloom often, but it can be encouraged to bloom by prolonged daily exposure to light. It is also very sensitive to moisture content; too much or too little water will cause the lower leaves to brown and fall off. It likes to be kept moist, but not wet. On average, it needs frequent, small amounts of water, as opposed to an occasional, thorough watering.

The plant flourishes when the temperature is in the range of 18-21 °C (65-70 °F); and will suffer if the temperature drops below 15 °C (60 °F) for prolonged periods."

Fully opaque model consists of 17,744 vertices or 34,578 tris.

* Albedo
* Occlusion + Roughness + Metallic
* Normal (Y+ Up)

00e9e6b9dbc34dc1ae691529688ab000.name: F111
00e9e6b9dbc34dc1ae691529688ab000.description:
The General Dynamics F-111 Aardvark was a supersonic, medium-range interdictor and tactical attack aircraft that also filled the roles of strategic nuclear bomber, aerial reconnaissance, and electronic-warfare aircraft in its various versions. Developed in the 1960s by General Dynamics, it first entered service in 1967 with the United States Air Force. The Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) also ordered the type and began operating F-111Cs in 1973.
The F-111 pioneered several technologies for production aircraft, including variable-sweep wings, afterburning turbofan engines, and automated terrain-following radar for low-level, high-speed flight. Its design influenced later variable-sweep wing aircraft, and some of its advanced features have since become commonplace. The F-111 suffered a variety of problems during initial development. Several of its intended roles, such as an aircraft carrier-based naval interceptor with the F-111B, failed to materialize.
Wikipedia

These beans are organic, don't worry..... super safe to eat........

History:
Beans are one of the longest-cultivated plants. Broad beans, also called fava beans, in their wild state the size of a small fingernail, were gathered in Afghanistan and the Himalayan foothills.In a form improved from naturally occurring types, they were grown in Thailand from the early seventh millennium BCE, predating ceramics. They were deposited with the dead in ancient Egypt. Not until the second millennium BCE did cultivated, large-seeded broad beans appear in the Aegean, Iberia and transalpine Europe.In the Iliad (8th century BCE) there is a passing mention of beans and chickpeas cast on the threshing floor. ans were an important source of protein throughout Old and New World history, and still are today.

049835e1a704492b925268629b04fe25.name: Starfish - Protoreaster nodosus
049835e1a704492b925268629b04fe25.description:
"Protoreaster nodosus, commonly known as the horned sea star or chocolate chip sea star, is a species of sea star found in the warm, shallow waters of the Indo-Pacific region. They are sometimes seen in the marine aquarium trade." - Wikipedia 

This starfish was located in the coral garden known as Siete Pecados off the coast of Coron, Philippines. The pictures (30) were taken with a GoPro Hero 3+ with 12 megapixel/wide settings. The pictures were not corrected for their barrel/fisheye distortion.

The sparse/dense clouds were created using VisualSFM, and imported into Meshlab where the dense cloud was cleaned and a Poisson mesh was generated, followed by texture mapping.

03123c98faad46faa39cb7d5158624ce.name: Gonolobus fruti
03123c98faad46faa39cb7d5158624ce.description:
Cuchampera, Gonolobus, an edible vine from Asclepiadaceae Family Liana with milky secretion (latex). 
Fruits green or yellowish green when ripe, with many seeds. 
Distributed from Guatemala to Costa Rica.

All parts of this plant, especially seeds and latex, are poisonous. 
Alkaloids used in medicine and as an insecticide. 
There is no record that the use of animals for food, but they are pollinated by insects.

There are several species belonging to this genus are edible and are commonly called "cuchampera" within which are:

Gonolobus barbatus
G. edulis
G. leianthus
G. salvinii
G. stenanthus
G. taylorianus

http://www.maya-ethnobotany.org/edible-nut-fruit-seed-tree-agroforestry-mayan-tropical-mayan-agriculture-diet-food-nutrition-health/cuchampera-gonolobus-asclepiadaceae-latex-vine.php

0109403d8b9f432a8e01676a21709c90.name: Ouse and Derwent Project: Samian ware
0109403d8b9f432a8e01676a21709c90.description:
A fragment of a Roman cup was discovered by a metal detectorist working with the Ouse and Derwent Project on the site of our 2018 excavation at North Duffield. It was red *terra sigillata*, 'Samian ware' that was imported from Central Gaul in modern day France.

Another distinctive sherd of Samian ware was recovered during the excavation, part of a flanged bowl. Both probably date to the 2nd century AD and are characteristically fine Roman table wares.

This is a 3D reconstruction of what the vessels would have looked like when new.

016630f444f946529e4457744eefa643.name: F. Wertheim & Co. passenger lift cabin

user.displayName: Museum of Engineering and Technology, Krakow

016630f444f946529e4457744eefa643.description:
Devices for the vertical transport of people and cargo have been known since ancient times. They consist mainly of a platform or cabin for the passengers or cargo, a rope with block and tackle, and a counterweight to the load being transported. Over time, the driving force in the lifting devices has been provided by animals, then steam, and finally the electric motor. The passenger lift cabin presented here, made of wood on a steel frame, was used in the Press Palace on Wielopole street in Kraków. It features a unique safety feature in the event that the rope snaps – a device that would catch the cabin in guides, developed by the American designer Elisha Graves Otis around the middle of the 19th century. The cabin was built in the 1920’s at a factory specialising in the production of metal safes and lift devices, F. Wertheim & Comp. 

Manufacturer: F. Wertheim & Co., 1920’s

Inv. No.: MIM1075/III-63

Model prepared on the basis of photogrammetric measurements.

Licence: CC BY-NC-SA

035940399e0f492ba614817a99243eb0.name: Bronze bell
035940399e0f492ba614817a99243eb0.description: Culture: [Roman](http://vocab.getty.edu/page/aat/300020541). Material: [Bronze](http://vocab.getty.edu/page/aat/300010957). Accession No: [HCA 622](http://www.huntmuseum.com/collection/bell-4/). Current Location: [The Hunt Museum,](https://www.huntmuseum.com/) [Limerick](https://www.geonames.org/7778675/limerick-city.html). This is a small bronze hollow-cast quadrilateral [bell](http://vocab.getty.edu/page/aat/300041874). The bell has a crown with a circular inner opening and irregular angular outer edge. The shoulder gently curves into four sides. The lip opening is squared with a larger fragment missing on one side. On the opposing side in the same location is a small circular hole. Small quadrilateral bells were made throughout the Roman world using the cire-perdue process. They had a variety of functions including hanging on windchimes to bring good luck to families. [More](https://www.huntmuseum.com/explore/item/d1a67d13-4235-39fb-8590-10b04f0c0473/?s%3Dbell&pos=2).

015e63fe1c9f4b0d8964e95805453231.name: Ancient Fountain, Via Talasesse, Arcidosso
015e63fe1c9f4b0d8964e95805453231.description:
A beautiful fountain on Via Talassese, Arcidosso, Grosseto, Tuscany. The dating is unknown although the stylized human face is similar to other specimens in the same area dated to the Renaissance period (cc. 16-17) and located in the public fountains of Castel del Piano and in the 'Pope fountain' at  the convent of St. Trinity near Santa Fiora. [source M. Nucciotti, 2003]

Model was created in Reality Capture using 486 photographs. The Mt. Amiata Project is an ongoing GDH collaboration involving faculty and students at the University of Florence and the University of Siena. We could not have done this project without the considerable support of the Municipality of Arcidosso.

027ac64798274c3297d2fe9b09ac7a09.name: Low poly sow
027ac64798274c3297d2fe9b09ac7a09.description: The way that we use words such as swine, sow, and porker when referring to humans shows how many people view pigs, as dirty and most importantly as less than humans. This appropriation of words extends beyond just pigs with words like bitch and heifer, to name just a few. With PIGment I want to explore this relationship by artistically ‘branding’ 3d models with some of these commonly used words. The font used as well as the size and color are meant to be bold and almost in your face. I want the viewer to feel the aggression that some of these words can often carry. The use of a common tattoo aesthetic, words in a scripty cursive font, serves to humanize this branding. By using something like a tattoo that can be seen throughout many areas of human culture it brings a human quality to the pig, placing the pig as an equal to the human rather than as a lesser being.

The Sanderling (*Calidris alba*) is a small wading sea bird that lives on the Canadian and American coasts. These small birds breed in the high arctic, but migrate down to warmer coasts during the winter. Although the beak is not represented accurately above, Sanderlings use their relatively long beaks to fish buried invertebrates out of the sand for food. 

The Polar Sea Star (*Leptasterias polaris*) is a six armed sea star the lives in the cold waters of the northwest Atlantic Ocean. Small and compact, this starfish is covered with blunt spiny plates and is usually brown or reddish in colour. The Polar Sea Star is a predator, feeding on bivalves such as the common blue mussel (*Mytilus edulis*). The adult sea stars can even feed on large gastropods such as the common whelk (*Buccinum undatum*). 

Both these creatures represent important parts of Canada’s coastal food webs and biodiversity.

010b9ece8a3a49e3b73be0b3cd02c720.name: Rose is a rose is a rose, except when it is not
010b9ece8a3a49e3b73be0b3cd02c720.description:
We live in Portland, OR – the home of some of the most beautiful roses ever grown, which also allows us amateur green thumbs to grow our own. Shavaun (the most scanned “wife” on Sketchfab) has been bitten by the Oregon climate and has cultivated several exceptionally beautiful roses in past couple of years. It is why I decided to clip (with her permission of course) three beautiful, but small roses to scan using Apple’s photogrammetry API in MacOS 12 & their demo dev iOS app. Unlike my previous method of rotating the camera around the object, I decided to use WWDC’s suggested method of using a motorized turntable. To my surprise it worked, and well at that. My theory why turntable scanning works is the iOS app also capture a depth map layer that is used to isolate the object even more from the background. 

Lit w. two RGB LED lights w. compact softboxes & a LED Ring light above. Blender was used to create baked AO/Shadow Diffuse, as well as specular, transparency & emission to fake subsurface light.

015f736a3c6b4daf83a7eaa49b351c45.name: Corset
015f736a3c6b4daf83a7eaa49b351c45.description:
The corset is made of French broached silk with Rococo floral patterns. It is lined with homespun canvas. It is made of three pieces: one at the back and two at the front. Six large inserts were sewn at the bottom, and metal rings along the cut, through which the ribbon used for tying was threaded. The corset was purchased in Dzianisz between 1887 and 1893 by Maria and Bronisław Dembowski, collectors of Podhale folk art, and in 1922 it was donated to the collection of the Tatra Museum under the provisions of Maria’s will.
It is one of the oldest well-preserved corsets from the Podhale region and the proof of direct or indirect cultural contacts stretching outside the region. It is patterned after the 18th-century bourgeois clothes.

ID no.: E/1851/MT

Time and place of creation: 19th century, Dzianisz, Podhale region, Poland

Museum: The Dr. Tytus Chałubiński Tatra Museum in Zakopane

https://muzea.malopolska.pl/en/objects-list/1794

Digitalisation: RDW MIC, Virtual Małopolska project

016627cce41a42cfb48db34becd7cbd8.description: One of the object for Japanese Room Set. A Zabuton is a Japanese cushion for sitting. The zabuton is generally used when sitting on the floor, and may also be used when sitting on a chair. For a more casual setting the zabuton can be used in conjunction with a zaisu, a type of Japanese legless chair, and with or without an accompanying kyousoku, a Japanese-style armrest. Ordinarily, any place in Japan where seating is on the floor will be provided with zabuton, for sitting comfort. A typical zabuton measures 50–70 cm square and is several centimetres thick when new. Zabuton are found throughout Japan, and enter many aspects of the culture. - Freebase

Scanned using advanced technology developed by inciprocal Inc. that enables highly photo-realistic reproduction of real-world products in virtual environments. 04dd9f6b6cf14003a7ccc8387ccee3ad.name: Alternating current electricity meter Czechowice

user.displayName: Museum of Engineering and Technology, Krakow

04dd9f6b6cf14003a7ccc8387ccee3ad.description:
The induction meter is the oldest (known already at the end of the 19th/beginning of the 20th century) and most widely used device to be used for the purposes of billing of alternating current power consumption. The operating principle of the device is based on the movement of a rotary disc in a magnetic field created by coils through which current flows. The readings can be read out on a drum counter. Nowadays, apart from induction meters, digital (electronic) meters are increasingly used, in which the flow of energy consumed by the customer generates impulses that are counted by the device. The main advantage of such meters is that they allow the remote reading of meters without the need for someone to physically inspect the meter. Just like induction meters, electronic meters can be used in single- or three-phase systems.

Manufacturer: Spółka Akcyjna Przemysłu Elektrycznego Czechowice, 1935

Inv. No.: MIM1712/IV-85

Model prepared on the basis of photogrammetric measurements.

Licence: CC BY-NC-SA

056cfd8c9b984719b1f96fd7829c981d.name: C5
056cfd8c9b984719b1f96fd7829c981d.description:
The Lockheed C-5 Galaxy is a large military transport aircraft originally designed and built by Lockheed, and now maintained and upgraded by its successor, Lockheed Martin. It provides the United States Air Force (USAF) with a heavy intercontinental-range strategic airlift capability, one that can carry outsize and oversize loads, including all air-certifiable cargo. The Galaxy has many similarities to its smaller Lockheed C-141 Starlifter predecessor, and the later Boeing C-17 Globemaster III. The C-5 is among the largest military aircraft in the world.

The C-5 Galaxy's development was complicated, including significant cost overruns, and Lockheed suffered significant financial difficulties. Shortly after entering service, cracks in the wings of many aircraft were discovered and the C-5 fleet was restricted in capability until corrective work was completed. The C-5M Super Galaxy is an upgraded version with new engines and modernized avionics designed to extend its service life beyond 2040.
